done.schema.input.title: Done request input
done.schema.input.description: Arguments for a Done operation. The credential and the Core address are wired from the done/api_key and done/base_url secrets.
done.schema.input.api_key.title: API key
done.schema.input.api_key.description: Bearer key for the Done Core. A secret reference, never a value.
done.schema.output.title: Done result
done.schema.output.description: {ok, id, state} on success, {ok: false, error: {code, message}} on failure.
done.schema.output.ok.title: OK
done.schema.output.ok.description: False when the operation failed; route on this.
done.schema.output.error.title: Error
done.schema.output.error.description: A stable code (permission_denied, blocked, rate_limited, invalid_recipient, invalid_request, unauthorised, not_found, unavailable) and a message.
